baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fronted object رُّجْزَ is followed by the result-like imperative فَٱهْجُرْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The object is read as recurrent disturbance rather than a static item, and the imperative prescribes cutting the connection that lets the disturbance continue.

activation_trace.role: Disturbance and successive motion supply a self-propagating process that can be interrupted.
Severance and separation supply the intervention: break connection rather than merely disapprove.

changed_reading.before: Avoid a bad or impure thing.
changed_reading.after: Cut the linkage that permits a recurrent agitation to keep propagating.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same رُّجْزَ object can denote an unstable field of repeated motion, while ٱهْجُرْ can encode departure between abodes.
baseline_models.mechanism: When disturbance has become an environment rather than one detachable act, separation takes the stronger form of relocation out of its operating space.

activation_trace.role: Persistent successive motion makes the object an unstable environment, not only a discrete offense.
Migration from one abode to another turns separation into a concrete change of location or affiliation.

changed_reading.before: Maintain distance from an objectionable object while remaining in place.
changed_reading.after: Leave the setting in which repeated disturbance has become the governing environment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رُّجْزَ has a verse branch, and the commanded هجر has branches of foul speech and an habitual refrain.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two focus roots can meet in a verbal mechanism: patterned utterance becomes a repeated habit, and the command cuts that cadence before it stabilizes as discourse.

activation_trace.role: Rajaz verse supplies patterned verbal cadence as the material being repeatedly produced.
Abandoned foul speech supplies the negative verbal content that the imperative can cut off.
A habitual refrain supplies repetition, making the target an entrenched speech practice rather than one utterance.

changed_reading.after: Break an entrenched verbal cadence that keeps objectionable speech in circulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening moves from being wrapped to rising with resolve and awakening caution. That sequence converts هجر from passive retreat into an active departure undertaken for a public warning task.

activation_trace.role: Successive disturbance supplies the unstable condition from which action must disengage.
Migration supplies purposeful departure, functioning here as movement into a different mode of life and work.
The outer covering supplies the initial enclosed state that the following commands overturn.
Resolve and rising to an affair supply mobilization, making separation an enacted transition.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the outward purpose served by leaving the disturbance.

structural_cues: The ordered opening runs from the covered addressee in 74:1 to the paired imperatives rise and warn in 74:2, then continues as a command sequence through 74:5.
The repeated imperative form prevents ٱهْجُرْ from reading as an inward sentiment alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, rising, warning, and migration; I infer the arrow enclosed stasis -> mobilized departure -> warning. A live alternative is that the opening commands are adjacent duties without this shared motion.

changed_reading.after: Exit the disturbed mode actively so that rising and warning become possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding clothing-purification command supplies a decontamination operation. Its mirrored syntax makes severance from recurrent disturbance the boundary-making counterpart to cleansing.

activation_trace.role: Repeated disturbance supplies contamination as something that can recur after a merely superficial cleaning.
Severance supplies the protective boundary that prevents renewed contact.
Clothing, including its use as a figure for the self, supplies the surface or person undergoing purification.
Purity as removal of filth supplies the cleaning operation that separation completes and preserves.

structural_cues: 74:4 and 74:5 both use wa + fronted object + fa + imperative: clothing/purify, then rujz/separate.
The two commands are contiguous, so cleansing and severance can function as complementary operations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the mirrored constructions and the clothing/self and impurity-removal images; I infer cleansing -> boundary -> reduced recontamination. The live alternative is two independent objects with no shared hygiene mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Cut an agitating connection in the abstract.
changed_reading.after: Clean the person or surface, then preserve that cleaning by severing recurrent sources of contamination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate ban on burdening a recipient while seeking increase, followed later by desire for still more, gives successive motion an acquisitive feedback form. The required هجر is a break with the habit of converting giving or possession into a claim on future increase.

activation_trace.role: Successive motion supplies the feedback loop by which one gain or favor presses toward the next.
Habitual practice supplies the entrenched acquisitive pattern that must be broken, not merely one transaction.
Burdening another by recalling a benefit supplies the social leverage that turns a gift into a claim.
Competing for numerical increase supplies the loop's growth criterion.
The heart's covetous hope supplies the appetite that keeps the loop running after abundance.
Seeking an increment supplies the explicit next turn of the feedback cycle.

structural_cues: 74:6 follows the focus command immediately and links conferral with seeking more.
74:12-15 narrates extended wealth, present sons, prepared ease, and then a demand for increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies burdening benefaction, numerical competition, covetous hope, and requested increase; I infer the arrow gift or possession -> entitlement -> renewed demand. A live alternative is that 74:6 concerns only boasting about favors, not expected return.

changed_reading.after: Break the acquisitive feedback habit that turns every benefit into leverage for further increase.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence shows inward oscillation and calculated framing becoming a spoken, transmissible dismissal. This activates the focus-only verbal model: the target is the whole production chain by which thought is engineered into a repeatable corrupting label.

activation_trace.role: Rajaz verse supplies patterned cadence, functioning as the repeatable packaging of the dismissal.
Foul speech supplies the verbal output that the command requires one to abandon.
A habitual refrain supplies circulation and recurrence beyond a single statement.
The heart's repeated turning over of a matter supplies the internal oscillation at the start of the pipeline.
Deliberate estimation and planning supply the reader-visible engineering step between thought and claim.
Attributing what is not so supplies the public verbal classification produced by the calculation.
Diversion and deception supply the dismissive category into which the sign is recoded.
Transmission of a report supplies the mechanism by which the engineered label becomes inherited and repeatable.

structural_cues: 74:18-24 stages thinking, estimating, looking, facial rejection, turning away, and finally speaking.
The claim in 74:24 is immediately reformulated as another categorical saying in 74:25.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered cognitive and bodily sequence ending in transmitted speech; I infer a production pipeline whose output feeds recurrence. A live alternative is that the sequence diagnoses one rejecter without retroactively specifying the object in 74:5.

changed_reading.after: Sever the full process that calculates, packages, voices, and retransmits a dismissive verbal formula.

context_deltas.mechanism: One test yields settled knowledge and increased trust in some, but disturbed doubt and diseased questioning in others, while remaining a reminder and a site of guidance. The focus command therefore targets the destabilizing response process, not the difficult sign that occasions it.

activation_trace.role: Successive disturbance supplies the oscillatory response that can arise around a test.
Severance supplies a selective break with destabilizing doubt while leaving the sign itself available.
Testing metal or a person supplies a common stimulus that reveals divergent response quality.
Settled knowledge with doubt removed supplies the stable response that disturbance does not govern.
Disturbed doubt supplies the closest contextual analogue to recurrent agitation.
Departure from health and equilibrium supplies the condition in which the test becomes destabilizing.
Gentle indication toward the path supplies the orientation that must remain after doubt is severed.
A reminder that restores attention supplies the positive object that must not be mistakenly abandoned.

structural_cues: Within 74:31 the same numerical test is followed by certainty, increase, and absence of doubt on one side, but diseased questioning and straying on the other.
The ayah closes by calling the material a reminder for humankind.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one test, opposed responses, guidance, and reminder; I infer that 74:5's selectable object is the agitated response mode rather than the test itself. A live alternative is that 74:31 explains outcomes without narrowing رُّجْزَ.

changed_reading.after: Remain with the test as reminder, but sever the oscillating doubt that prevents it from settling into guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later accountability sequence turns disturbance into a social current: one enters a path, wades with other waders, acquires consequences, and becomes held by them. هجر is preventive route-exit from collective entrainment before repeated participation becomes one's collateral.

activation_trace.role: Successive motion supplies entrainment, in which repeated participation carries a person along.
Migration supplies a route change out of the collective environment rather than a private opinion about it.
Acquisition supplies the accumulation of actions as consequences owned by the participant.
Collateral held against a claim supplies the endpoint at which accumulated participation binds the self.
Passing into a road supplies the directional channel by which repeated choices lead into an endpoint.
Entering water supplies the material image of immersion in a current, while the doubled occurrence and company make it collective.

structural_cues: 74:38 states that each self is held by what it acquires before 74:42 asks what route brought the speakers into Saqar.
The confession in 74:43-46 places failure of worship and feeding, collective wading, and denial in one repeated first-person-plural sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path-entry, doubled wading with companions, acquisition, and collateral; I infer the arrow social current -> repeated participation -> binding consequence. A live alternative is that water-entry is only an idiom for talk and does not imply entrainment.

changed_reading.before: Separate as an isolated individual from an abstract disturbance.
changed_reading.after: Change routes out of a collective current before shared repetition becomes acquired and binding consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The commanded separation is bounded by a later negative image of separation: turning away from reminder and fleeing in frightened reaction. Thus هجر is disciplined severance from disturbance while remaining receptive to reminder, not indiscriminate escape from whatever alarms or pursues.

activation_trace.role: Disturbance supplies the proper object of separation, which the later contrast prevents from expanding to every alarming encounter.
Deliberate severance supplies the controlled action contrasted with reactive flight.
The reminder supplies the positive encounter from which withdrawal is condemned.
Turning one's side away supplies intentional refusal of the reminder, a false analogue to commanded separation.
Recoiling and distancing supply the reactive separation whose object and motive are wrong.
Flight supplies panic-driven movement away, distinguishing reflexive escape from ethical severance.
A powerful pursuer supplies the perceived threat that triggers undisciplined flight.

structural_cues: 74:49 names the reminder as the object of turning away, and 74:50-51 immediately renders that response as a flight simile.
74:54 then reasserts that the discourse is a reminder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deliberate turning, recoil, flight, pursuit, and repeated reminder; I infer that this negative departure constrains the earlier positive command by object and motive. A live alternative is that the simile condemns rejecters without defining the manner of هجر in 74:5.

changed_reading.before: Flee whatever feels disturbing or threatening.
changed_reading.after: Sever the recurrent disturbance deliberately, but do not convert that command into panic flight from reminder.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the branch-distant carrier counterweight with migration, yet both attach directly to the two focus words and yield a coherent load-and-exit mechanism. Render it only as a material analogy, not as a replacement gloss for either lexeme.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رُّجْزَ supplies the counterweight used to correct a tilted load, and ٱهْجُرْ supplies leaving one abode for another.

activation_trace.role: A counterweight that corrects a carrier's tilt supplies a system kept usable by compensating for instability rather than removing it.
Migration supplies exit from the burdened arrangement instead of adding another compensating weight.

changed_reading.before: Keep correcting the tilt so the burden can continue to be carried.
changed_reading.after: Leave an arrangement sustained only by compensatory burdens; balancing its disturbance is not curing it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses packet-authorized non-dominant split mappings for ق و ل and ء ث ر, making speech oscillate and transmission stir movement. It remains anchored through the focus verse, foul-speech branches, and the actual utterance in 74:24; downstream prose should label it an exploratory cross-root activation, not a direct lexical claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins the rajaz-verse branch of ر ج ز with the foul-speech branch of ه ج ر, while 74:24 supplies the spoken and transmitted event.

activation_trace.role: Rajaz verse supplies rhythmic verbal form, functioning as a cadence that can sustain recurrence.
Foul speech supplies the objectionable verbal content that remains directly anchored to the imperative.
The split-root image of oscillation and movement makes the act of saying itself a perturbation in the exploratory mechanism.
The split-root image of stirring and moving something from place supplies propagation of that verbal perturbation.

changed_reading.before: A speaker produces one false label.
changed_reading.after: Cut a rhythmic verbal perturbation before transmission turns it into a self-renewing refrain.

strongest_changes: The opening sequence and the exact 74:4/74:5 syntactic parallel turn generic avoidance into active, boundary-preserving decontamination.
The opposed responses inside 74:31 distinguish abandoning destabilized doubt from abandoning the difficult sign or reminder itself.
The path, wading, acquisition, collateral, and later flight sequence recasts separation as disciplined exit from collective entrainment, not panic withdrawal.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots already encode motion plus severance, while their remote counterweight, verse, foul-speech, and habitual-refrain branches let later material activate physical, verbal, cognitive, economic, and social mechanisms without forcing them into one final gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: The degree to which the rajaz-verse and habitual-refrain branches are intended activations rather than useful branch-distant analogies remains uncertain.
It is uncertain whether 74:31 and 74:49-51 retroactively constrain the object and manner of the early command or only exemplify its wider stakes.
The exact denotation of رُّجْزَ remains open, so the retained process models should coexist rather than be collapsed into one referent.
